partition.statement: Active B, x≥0. Odd winding sector; published 12-point replay.

parity.statement: Full kernel at two twists; even L is an abstract control.
parity.formula: dim ker i(F-F†)=(3,1) for even N; (2,2) for odd N

factor.statement: Sign on the last source of the long cycle.

overlap.statement: Twisted eigenbasis; Z and I have the same transition intensities.

channels.statement: Uniform periodic input under one antiperiodic step, measured in the old kernel.

sign_controls.statement: Cycle products for five explicit signed lifts on odd L=3,5,7,9,15.

commutation.statement: L=7, single-vertex grading; swap S01 is even, rank-two edge hop odd.

hazard_controls.statement: Totals and mode-resolved hazards depend on operator and drive.

transient.statement: L=7, x=4, b=0; half fixed / half uniform, dimensionless t=1.

response_input.statement: Ten central differences; positive/negative amplitude 0.00030 MeV.

response_rank.statement: First-order ranks in the stored basis, unweighted.
response_rank.formula: rank M=4; rank M_hold restricted to ker M_D=3

relic_control.statement: One fixed density screen at 80 keV; exact Bose integral for a collisionless relic.

physical_rate.statement: Obtain sector dynamics, bath spectrum and absolute normalization from a specified interaction.

nuclear_bridge.statement: Obtain a signed nuclear response independently of the fitted abundances.

local_box.statement: Tangent response for differences bounded by 0.30 keV per knot; fixed linear D/H.
local_box.formula: max m_He·a for |a_i|≤0.00030 MeV, m_D·a=0; primal plus dual check

ceiling.statement: Finite active-layer bias bounded strictly for x>0; proof in README. Checked finite samples and limit to numeric tolerance.
